title: Complete Sankey direct launch and release processing state
fixtures: COVID_Dummy_distance_edgelist_snp.csv; AngularTesting_DistanceMatrix_TN93_BS.xlsx; SARSCoV2_Simulated_Sequences_snp.fas; TestStyleNodelist_snp.csv; TestStyleEdgelist_snp.csv; AngularTesting_nodelist_withseqs_TN93_BS.csv; AngularTesting_seqs_TN93_BS.nwk; AngularTesting_Epi_linklist_BS.csv
observed_behavior: When the pre-launch default view is forced to `Sankey`, uploaded direct-launch does not reliably reach the Sankey surface. On the maintained node+link fixture the app can stay behind `Processing Files...`, and on the maintained distance-edgelist fixture processing completes but `#sankey-container` never renders and Cypress captures a blank shell instead.
intended_behavior: Uploaded datasets should be able to honor `default-view = Sankey`, clear the Processing Files flow, and land directly in an interactive Sankey view without requiring a post-launch view switch.
cause_summary: The shared launch-view wiring recognized `Sankey`, but Sankey did not participate in the shared launch-render completion path, so direct launch could leave the Processing Files modal unresolved. The Cypress pre-launch helper was also targeting the zero-size `p-dialog` host instead of the visible PrimeNG dialog wrapper.
fix_summary: Expose `Sankey` in File Settings, mark Sankey rendered once its initial mounted state is ready so direct launch clears the shared processing modal, and target the visible PrimeNG File Settings dialog wrapper in the Cypress pre-launch helper.
notes: Resolved on 2026-04-04. The maintained direct-launch Sankey smoke matrix now passes across all seven uploaded file-type paths and the legacy upload-then-switch Sankey smoke still passes.
